description: This source file is a Java class implementing the Concept Data Access Object (DAO) for the OpenMRS platform, using Hibernate ORM. It provides methods for retrieving, saving, updating, and deleting concepts, drugs, concept classes, reference terms, and related entities from the database, including search and indexing functionalities. It encapsulates the database interactions for concept-related data within the OpenMRS medical records system.

classes.name: HibernateConceptDAO
classes.description: Implements the ConceptDAO interface using Hibernate to perform CRUD operations, searches, and indexing for concept-related data entities within the OpenMRS system.
